title: November 1, 2026 Ripple escrow execution: two EscrowFinish releases totaling 1B XRP

methodology_claim.provider_statement: The tracker states that it reads rippled JSON-RPC from s1.ripple.com with xrplcluster.com as fallback, uses account_objects(type=escrow) and account_tx metadata at one pinned validated ledger, and does not use explorer caches or aggregators.

observations.trailing_12_month_window: December 2025 through November 2026; November is included at the 00:27 UTC snapshot with zero re-escrow observed by that cutoff.

verification_boundary.interpretation: The tracker reports the two EscrowFinish releases from its pinned ledger-derived history. This run did not retrieve raw transaction JSON or independently decode the Destination fields. The 1B net-outside-escrow figure is valid only at ledger 108034152 and may change if later EscrowCreate transactions occur.

source_independence.note: The source states that it queries public rippled JSON-RPC directly. The two linked XRPL Explorer pages require JavaScript and did not provide independently parsed transaction metadata in this run.
